title: Delivery Radar
noBoardTitle: No project has a GitHub Project board
noBoardHint: Link a board in a project's Settings → GitHub Project and map its Deadline field to track who is late.
bannerNoBoard: {project}: no Deadline field mapped on the GitHub Project board — its issues all count as "No deadline".
bannerSkippedNonGithub: {project}: non-GitHub repos skipped (GitLab not supported yet).
bannerTruncated: {project}: list truncated (a repo has too many open issues).

statusHint.overdue: Deadline has passed and the issue is still open
statusHint.due-soon: Deadline is today or within the next {days} days
statusHint.not-started: Start date has passed but the board status is still To do / Backlog
statusHint.stale: No update on the issue for more than {days} days
statusHint.no-deadline: No Deadline set on the GitHub Project board
statusHint.on-track: Deadline is further out and the issue is moving

filterHint: Click to show only this status
nothingHint: No open issue matches the current filters.

doneStatuses.buttonHint: Who the testers are and which board statuses mean handed to QA / done — set once for all projects
doneStatuses.title: When is an issue done?
doneStatuses.testersHint: Click to mark someone as a tester: they stay on an issue until it is Done. Everyone else is a developer, done once it reaches QA.
doneStatuses.noPeople: No assignee found yet — refresh the radar first.
doneStatuses.hint: Applies to every project; statuses with the same name share a stage. Guessed from the name — only fix the wrong ones.

stageHint.dev: The developer is still on it
stageHint.qa: Done for the developer, the tester is on it

doneStatuses.noOptions: No status found yet — refresh the radar after mapping the board's Status field.

testerHint: Tester — done only at Ready for release / Done
inheritedDeadline: Deadline taken from the parent issue
